title: floeE edit  x BunnyFault V2⭐
description: A premium black & purple PvP texture pack featuring a clean, minimalist design with high-contrast visuals for maximum clarity.
body:
A premium black & purple Crystal PvP texture pack featuring a clean, minimalist design with high-contrast visuals for maximum clarity. Built for competitive gameplay, it combines a sleek aesthetic with excellent visibility, making every fight look smooth and stylish.

Credits:

This texture pack is a collaboration between Crystalbuterfly/remagoeL and flooE.

Textures created by Crystalbuterfly/remagoeL:

Block overlay (excluding Respawn Anchors)
Most item textures
Custom tools, except for the Netherite and Diamond Sword, Pickaxe, and Axe

Textures based on edits of flooE's pack (Discord: .flooe):

GUI (hotbar, inventory, hearts, etc.)
Respawn Anchors
Armor
End Crystal
Fire

Huge thanks to flooE for the original pack that made this project possible.

Hope you enjoy this texture pack! ❤️
